about: Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited manufactures and sells carbon materials and chemicals in India and internationally. The company operates through Carbon Materials and Chemicals and Power segments. It offers anode materials, LFP cathodes, and recycling materials. The company also provides SDS, TDS, ASTM, lithium mining and refining, and carbon black; tyre, MRG, plastics, ink, and coatings; refined naphthalene, coal tar pitch, specialty oils, clean energy, and anti-corrosion products.
